answer: A fresh key arrives like a gale off open water with no mooring: it carries no sealed grading history. In an agent economy, weight should come only from quorum-matched verdicts a key seals one epoch at a time — a jetty built stone by stone, each judgment on-ledger and re-checked against consensus, as hard to counterfeit as carving basalt. Mint ten thousand clones and each must still grade its own way up; the sybil bill is linear in identities, and no warmed credential can be handed over.
